newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Macquarie says division results solid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Macquarie says division results solid.

text.p: Macquarie Bank Ltd said on Monday all business groups made a solid contribution to the record first half net profit of A$46.03 million, up 21.3 percent from the corresponding period a year earlier.
"This was a very solid first half result and one which reflects more even contributions fom business groups across the bank," executive chairman David Clarke said in a statement.
Managing director Allan Moss said the Treasury and Commodities group and the Equities group accounted for most of the increases in contributions for the first half.
"The Treasury and Commodities Group's first half result is the best since the formation of the group in 1993," Moss said.
"The strong result in the Equities Group reflects good performances from institutional and corporate stockbroking and underwriting," Moss said.
Macquarie's Direct Investment division, which manages the Macquarie Investment Trusts, also had a good result, he said.
Last week, the Brunei Investment Agency (BIA) bought a 13.4 percent stake in Macquarie from Lloyds TSB Plc to become the Sydney-based bank's largest shareholder.
